SELECT u.id, u.email, u.nick_name, COALESCE(a.role, 'USER') AS role, u.created_at, u.password_hash <> 'SOCIAL_ONLY' AS has_password, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM social_accounts s WHERE s.user_id = u.id) AS has_google, p.birth_date, p.gender, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM refresh_token r WHERE r.user_id = u.id AND r.expires_at > NOW()) AS active_sessions, (SELECT MAX(r.created_at) FROM refresh_token r WHERE r.user_id = u.id AND r.expires_at > NOW()) AS last_used_at FROM users u LEFT JOIN admin_accounts a ON a.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user_profiles p ON p.user_id = u.id
ORDER BY u.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users u LEFT JOIN admin_accounts a ON a.user_id = u.id
SELECT COALESCE(a.role, 'USER') FROM users u LEFT JOIN admin_accounts a ON a.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{id}
SELECT email FROM users WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_accounts (user_id, role, granted_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{role}, #{grantedBy}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE role = VALUES(role), granted_by = VALUES(granted_by)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE created_at >= #{since}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM social_accounts WHERE provider = 'GOOGLE'
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM users WHERE created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY label

SELECT CASE WHEN p.birth_date IS NULL THEN '미입력' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.birth_date, CURDATE()) >= 50 THEN '50대 이상' ELSE CONCAT(FLOOR(TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.birth_date, CURDATE()) / 10) * 10, '대') END AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_profiles p ON p.user_id = u.id GROUP BY label
SELECT COALESCE(p.gender, '미입력') AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_profiles p ON p.user_id = u.id GROUP BY label
